item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L021 executed successfully and passed the deterministic positive-Tc guard: 8.6254 K was below the fixed G01 limit of 8.8322 K. However, its pooled weighted training OOF MAE was 7.8015 K, which is 0.0489 K worse than A05's 7.7526 K and 0.0589 K above the eligible threshold of 7.7426 K, so it was not an eligible improvement. Relative to L007, adding the route-trained fe_anion extra_trees/log1p expert worsened pooled MAE from 7.7612 K to 7.8015 K and positive-Tc MAE from 8.4615 K to 8.6254 K; although reported-zero MAE improved from 6.2051 K to 5.9709 K, high-Tc MAE worsened from 28.8502 K to 29.0322 K. This is another zero-versus-positive tradeoff, while large opposing cu_o errors remained. The guard pass cannot compensate for failure to achieve the required 0.01 K pooled-MAE gain.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"The continuation minimum remains pending, with 21 of 22 successful unique cycles completed. Test an untried variant of L021 using composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/log1p, cu_o extra_trees/raw, and other hist_gradient_boosting/raw, with fe_anion omitted so it uses the global fallback. L021 shows that route-trained fe_anion extra_trees/log1p is harmful, while A05 versus A01 indicates that global fallback can outperform a route-trained fe_anion expert even with the same estimator and raw target. This isolates whether broader global training makes the log1p fallback less harmful while retaining L007's near-incumbent cu_o and other configuration. The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE is at most 8.832165507919859 K; isolated subgroup gains remain tradeoffs.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All measurements are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L021 passed the positive-Tc guard but failed the required 0.01 K pooled-MAE improvement criterion.","Chemistry routes are operational composition partitions rather than verified physical families.","The reported counterexamples are historical prediction errors and do not identify new superconductors."]}
